test.create_query: CREATE TABLE threshold_top_k_perf ENGINE = MergeTree ORDER BY () AS SELECT /* millions of groups with a heavy skew: drawing the group id uniformly from a range that is itself uniform makes the small ids far more frequent (about harmonically), so a few hot groups dominate while the tail keeps the cardinality high */ intHash64(rand64() % (1 + rand64() % 10000000)) AS k, number AS v, number % 1000000 AS u FROM numbers_mt(40000000)
